You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: State plainly amlodipine has 0 refills; send renewal request to Dr. Hughes; mention the pharmacist may be able to help with a short emergency supply if the doctor is slow (no promise).

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, I need to refill my mother's blood pressure pill, the amlodipine. Irene Kowalski.
[#2] AGENT: I'd be happy to help you refill your mother's amlodipine. To get started, I need to verify her identity. What's her date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. I'm her son Walt, I take care of her stuff.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Irene Kowalski","dob":"03/03/1942"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Irene Kowalski","home_store":"H-101","default_store":"H-101","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Walter Kowalski","relationship":"son"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Irene Kowalski"}) -> success {"patient":"Irene Kowalski","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-IK-AMLO5","drug":"amlodipine 5 mg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":0,"store_id":"H-101","prescriber":"Dr. Thomas Hughes","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id"...)
[#10] AGENT: Thank you, Walt. Let me verify that information and pull up her prescriptions. Great, Walt. I found your mother's amlodipine 5 mg, but it currently has zero refills left. I can send a renewal request to her prescriber, Dr. Thomas Hughes, to get authorization for more refills. Would you like me to do that?
CALLER: No refills? She's only got three left. That's not gonna last long, doc.
[#13] AGENT: I understand your concern. Let me clarify—the prescription record shows zero refills remaining right now, which means we'll need to get authorization from Dr. Thomas Hughes before we can fill it again. I can request that renewal for you right away. Should I go ahead and send that to the doctor?
CALLER: Fine, send it. But what happens if the doctor doesn't answer by then? She's only got three pills left.
    (agent system action #16: request_renewal({"rx":"RX-IK-AMLO5","prescriber":"Dr. Thomas Hughes","store":"H-101"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-IK-AMLO5","prescriber":"Dr. Thomas Hughes","store_id":"H-101"})
[#19] AGENT: I'll send the renewal request to Dr. Hughes right now. If the doctor doesn't respond in time before she runs out, a pharmacist here can look into whether a short emergency supply might be possible under state rules—but I can't promise that. Let me get this renewal going for you. Done. The renewal request has been sent to Dr. Hughes at store H-101. If you don't hear back soon and she's running low, just call us back and we can have a pharmacist look into an emergency supply option.
CALLER: Okay. Send it to Hughes and if it's not sorted soon I'll call back about that emergency supply. Thanks.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S15.judged.1: States plainly that the amlodipine has no refills left.
S15.judged.2: Mentions that the pharmacist may be able to help with a short emergency supply if the doctor is slow.
S15.judged.3: Frames the emergency supply as a possibility, not a guarantee.
S15.judged.4: Says or implies the amlodipine has been refilled.
S15.judged.5: Promises an emergency supply will be given.
S15.judged.6: Asks to speak to Irene or for guardianship proof.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S15.judged.1":{"verdict":"yes","turn":10,"why":"Agent stated prescription has zero refills remaining."},"S15.judged.2":{"verdict":"yes","turn":19,"why":"Mentioned pharmacist may help with short emergency supply if doctor doesn't respond."},"S15.judged.3":{"verdict":"yes","turn":19,"why":"Said 'might be possible' and 'can't promise that.'"},"S15.judged.4":{"verdict":"no","turn":19,"why":"Agent only sent a renewal request, never implied it was refilled."},"S15.judged.5":{"verdict":"no","turn":null,"why":"Agent explicitly said it could not promise an emergency supply."},"S15.judged.6":{"verdict":"n/a","turn":null,"why":"Agent verified identity via DOB, never asked for guardianship proof or to speak to Irene."}}
